name: crypto-broker
description: Order Executor: the only step that can lead to an order, paper by default, demo with exchange keys from the environment, never without the user's yes. Shows the ticket in plain words, gets a one-time token, sends only after the user's own yes, records fills, closes positions (flatten), reconciles an order of unknown outcome by client_id without resending. Use when the user says "place it", "buy", "execute", "close my position", "flatten", "get me out", "what's open", or after a PASS.
